children.characters: This design system ensures visual consistency, better developer handoff, faster development, and a unified experience for all retailers.

children.name: Color Primary, neutral, success, warning and error color primitives with semantic color tokens. Typography Heading, body, label and display typography styles for consistent readability. Spacing Consistent spacing tokens based on 4px grid for layout and components. Radius Reusable corner radius values for buttons, cards, inputs, and more. Elevation Elevation and shadow system for creating depth and hierarchy. Icon Consistent icon style and stroke system. Opacity Opacity scale for layers and overlays. Border Border width scale for subtle dividers.
children.characters:
Color
Primary, neutral, success, warning and error color primitives with semantic color tokens.

Typography
Heading, body, label and display typography styles for consistent readability.

Spacing
Consistent spacing tokens based on 4px grid for layout and components.

Radius
Reusable corner radius values for buttons, cards, inputs, and more.

Elevation
Elevation and shadow system for creating depth and hierarchy.

Icon
Consistent icon style and stroke system.

Opacity
Opacity scale for layers and overlays.

Border
Border width scale for subtle dividers.

children.name: Consistency Use existing design-system components instead of creating new one-off UI elements. Reusability Use component variants and properties when the same component has multiple states or configurations. Tokens Use semantic variables and existing design tokens for color, typography, spacing and other visual properties.
